title: Member 4 XJTU Feature Scientific Provenance Audit
scope: 67 SOHbenchmark XJTU handcraft feature columns and their current Member 4 candidate calculations; no source code or formulas changed.
classification_scope: Classification applies to current implemented candidate expressions, not whether an original workbook formula is verified.

classification_definitions.A: Verified directly from authoritative source for exact workbook feature and matching context.
classification_definitions.B: Same mathematical operation appears in source, but exact workbook identity/context is not established.
classification_definitions.C: Engineering candidate; no inspected source supports complete feature definition as implemented.
classification_definitions.D: Diagnostic proxy or approximation for unavailable original feature definition.

pooled_time_increment_min.uniformity_test: Each within-cycle dt matched that cycle median within rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-9; intervals vary between cycles.

capacity.unit: Not explicit in inspected loader; 2.0 normalization constant is documented in code, not as a unit.
